ModMetaData.name: Modmixer Live
ModMetaData.author: Modmixer
ModMetaData.description: Experimental in-game live-modding companion for the Modmixer desktop app. Adds an in-game chat window for prompting the Modmixer agent, and applies what the agent sends back — hot-loaded assemblies, one-shot C# actions, and def reloads — over a localhost connection. Requires the Modmixer app; installed automatically for live sessions.
